facts.label: When e after
facts.sub: Use when ou after + presente para o momento, e I’ll + verbo para a ação: When I get there, I’ll call you.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when + presente para falar de um momento futuro: When I finish work, I’ll call you. Depois de when, o verbo fica no presente. Depois, use I’ll + verbo para dizer o que vai acontecer.

facts.label: Depois que
facts.sub: After quer dizer depois de. Diga After I leave, I’ll send a message. A estrutura é igual à de when: presente depois de after e will no resultado.

pages.title: A busy café · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in a busy café in Los Angeles. Cars pass by the big window. Paul drinks an iced tea. His friend Noah comes in with his phone. They want to meet tonight. Paul asks about the time.
“Hi, Noah! What time are we meeting tonight?” says Paul. “I’m not sure. When I finish work, I’ll call you.” says Noah. “OK. When do you finish?” says Paul.
